title: Apply for an international paintball competitor permit
summary: Use this page to apply for an international paintball competitor permit to bring a paintball marker into NSW from overseas.
intro:
You need an international paintball competitor permit to bring a paintball marker (paintball gun) into NSW from overseas.

The permit is valid for one year.
who_can_apply: Pass a 'fit and proper' person assessment
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for a paintball marker permit'
The PDF form: 'Paintball permit additional details form' (if applicable)
Details of the NSW competition you will be competing in

how_to_steps.text: Submit your payment online and enter the receipt number on the application form.
Download and complete the Paintball permit additional details form – PDF if applicable.
Email the form and supporting documents using the details on the form.

faqs.q: How long is the international paintball competitor permit valid for?
faqs.a: The permit is valid for one year.

faqs.q: What are the requirements to apply for the permit?
faqs.a: You must be aged 18 or over, pass a 'fit and proper' person assessment, and live outside Australia.

faqs.q: How can I pay the fee for the permit?
faqs.a: Payment methods include Paypal, or a credit or debit card.
